title: New Spectrum TCP/UDP app created in dashboard does not enforce IP Access Rules
symptoms: Blocked IPs from IP Access Rules can still connect to a newly created Spectrum application
Dashboard-created app behaves differently from an older app on the same zone
cause: Since the Spectrum dashboard redesign on 2026-11-19, new TCP and UDP applications created in the dashboard have IP Access Rules turned off by default, matching the API default. Existing applications keep their setting.
fix: Turn on IP Access Rules in the application's Advanced Options when creating or editing it, if you rely on those rules to block traffic.
apply: Dashboard: Spectrum > Applications > select hostname > Advanced Options > turn on IP Access Rules
affected: Spectrum TCP and UDP applications created in the dashboard on or after 2026-11-19
